palindrome:
A palindrome is a word or phrase that reads the same backward as forward. Here's a palindrome that is 255 characters long:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
```

This palindrome is a repetition of the well-known phrase "Able was I ere I saw Elba" six times, which results in 255 characters in total.
